message.content: {"caption":"A skill-learning workflow is paired with a training-performance comparison, showing how trajectories are distilled into reusable skills and how success rates change over training.","description":"Composite figure with a workflow diagram above a line chart. In the diagram, a base model interacts with an environment and produces trajectories; successful episodes are retained as expert examples and failures are discarded, contributing to memory and a skills library that can evolve. The chart plots Success Rate (%) against Training Steps for Vanilla GRPO (blue), GRPO+Memory (gray dashed), and SkillRL (Ours, red). SkillRL rises faster and remains highest; the other two curves increase more gradually. Highlighted markers indicate approximate read-offs, and the plot also includes a legend and callouts for higher performance and faster convergence.","figure_type":"chart","chart_values":[{"series":"SkillRL (Ours)","category":null,"x":75,"value":90,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"GRPO+Memory","category":null,"x":90,"value":62,"value_status":"estimated"},{"series":"Vanilla GRPO","category":null,"x":106,"value":74,"value_status":"estimated"}]}
